title: The Azure Basin Great Axe Canon
summary: A school canon that teaches the great axe as a weight poured into the basin of an enemy's stance.

title: Dual-Track Greataxe Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of the dual-track method applied to the greataxe with one edge carried on both tracks.

title: Treatise of the River-Cut Hewing
summary: A school treatise on hewing strokes that cut their own channel through a guard as a river cuts a bed.

title: Azure Court Axe Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of the court that sets out the full order of paired blows for the highest mortal ranks.

title: Great Axe Doctrine of the Hawk and Basin
summary: A doctrine that joins the hawk's fall to the basin's floor in a single downward school.

title: Canon of the Unbroken Azure Descent
summary: A canon of one long descent from the sky onto a single point that is never broken once begun.

title: The Plateau Oath Axe Doctrine
summary: A doctrine that binds the great axe to an oath sworn at the plateau's edge and kept in every stroke.

title: Hewing Course of the Held Bearing
summary: A course in taking a bearing on the foe and holding it through every stroke of the hewing.

title: Doctrine of the Wind-Carried Axe
summary: A doctrine in which the wind bears the weight of the axe and the wielder only guides its fall.

title: Canon of the Open Edge Oath
summary: A canon for the highest mortal ranks on keeping an oath with the axe where nothing stands behind them.

title: Treatise on the Gale-Sworn Great Axe
summary: A treatise on the great axe sworn to the gale itself and carried by it through every guard.

title: The Unwalled Plateau Axe Canon
summary: A canon of a standing axe on open ground that holds the plateau against all comers without walls.
